how_to_apply: Visit the official website ignou.ac.in and access the prescribed online Application Proforma for the relevant post and discipline.
Read the detailed notice, qualifications, experience, and screening criteria available on the website before filling the form.
Fill in complete and correct personal, educational, and experience details. Data once entered cannot be changed – review carefully before final submission.
Upload all supporting documents (certificates, experience proof, publications, etc.) with the application.
Pay the applicable application fee online via credit/debit card or net banking.
Submit the application within the prescribed time limit (by 20.10.2026 or 30 days from Employment News publication, whichever is later).
Take a printout of the confirmed online application.

Send the printed application along with self-attested copies of all required certificates/documents, properly bound/tagged and page-numbered, by registered/speed post to: The Director, Academic Coordination Division, IGNOU, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi-110068, on or before 30.10.2026. The envelope must clearly indicate the post, discipline, School, and Advertisement No.

content_sections.heading: IGNOU Recruitment 2026 Eligibility
content_sections.text: M.B.B.S. with M.D./M.S. from an MCI-recognized Medical College, as per MCI Teacher Eligibility Qualification Regulations, in preventive & social medicine / community medicine / hospital administration / community health administration 8 years of post-PG experience Associate Professor in the subject for a minimum 3 years in an MCI-recognized Medical College/Institution, with 4 research publications in indexed journals (minimum 2 during the Associate Professor tenure as first/corresponding author) Master's degree in Nursing with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) Minimum 14 years of teaching experience after M.Sc. Nursing as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor in a College of Nursing/University Desirable: independent published work of high standard, or a doctorate/M.Phil. Minimum eligibility conditions follow UGC Regulations, 2018 and subsequent amendments (including the 2023 Amendment Regulations); norms of NCTE, MCI, etc. also apply where relevant to the post Minimum 55% marks (or equivalent grade) at Master's level is essential for direct recruitment of teachers at any level 5% marks relaxation (55% to 50%) at Bachelor's and Master's level for SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer)/PwBD candidates in the respective category advertised 5% marks relaxation to Ph.D. holders who obtained their Master's degree before 19 September 1991 Time taken to acquire M.Phil./Ph.D. is not counted as teaching/research experience; active service pursued simultaneously with a research degree (without availing leave) is counted as teaching experience Cut-off date for determining eligibility conditions is the last date of submission of the online application

rows.requirement: An eminent scholar with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, actively engaged in research, with a minimum of 10 research publications in peer-reviewed/UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations, 2018 (Appendix II, Table 2)
Minimum 10 years of teaching experience as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or equivalent research experience, with evidence of having successfully guided a doctoral candidate

An outstanding professional with a Ph.D. in the relevant/allied/applied discipline from institutions not covered under A, or from industry, with significant documented contribution to the discipline and 10 years' experience

content_sections.heading: IGNOU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process (Screening & Interview)
content_sections.text: Selection is interview-based (no written exam). For Professor posts, applications are first screened and scored by a Screening Committee against a weighted research/academic-credential scale; shortlisted candidates are then called for interview by the Selection Committee. Full category list (research papers, books, e-content/MOOCs, curricula design, research guidance, projects, patents, policy documents, awards, invited lectures) and detailed point values are in Appendix I of the official notification; research score must come from a minimum of 3 out of 6 categories Combined research score from "Policy Document" and "Invited Lectures/Resource Person" categories is capped at 30% of the teacher's total research score Up to 15 candidates will be called for interview per Professor post, based on descending merit from the screening score Screening/shortlisting marks carry no weightage in the final Selection Committee interview assessment Publications "under submission" or sent to referees are not considered for scoring

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGNOU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Only online application, with the corresponding hard copy received by post within the deadline, is treated as complete. Loose/unbound documents and applications submitted only offline are not accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates (Master's/Ph.D./M.Phil., as applicable) with mark sheets Experience certificates clearly indicating pay scale and gross pay drawn Offer of appointment letters and Form 16/passbook/payslip entries showing actual pay drawn Copies of promotion orders, if promoted during service Copies of research publications with cover page and content page of the Research Journal Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD) valid for the current financial year (2026-27), where applicable Disability certificate (for PwBD posts, minimum 40% disability) No Objection Certificate and Vigilance Clearance Certificate (for candidates serving in Universities/Colleges/Government/PSUs) Proof of earlier fee payment (for candidates re-applying against Advt No. 02/2022/ACD or 02/2023/ACD) Valid photo ID (Aadhaar/Voter ID/Driving License/Passport) at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Mere fulfilment of qualification/experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview; the number of candidates called is determined by the University Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification No TA/DA is paid to candidates for attending the interview Any corrigendum/addendum will be posted only on the University website (ignou.ac.in) The University reserves the right to amend eligibility conditions, number of posts, or selection criteria, and to not fill any post, without assigning reasons Applications processed on a self-certification basis; responsibility for false/incorrect information lies solely with the applicant, with liability for legal action Candidates already selected/appointed on the basis of incorrect or forged credentials are liable to have their candidature/service cancelled at any stage Any dispute regarding the recruitment falls under the jurisdiction of Delhi OBC candidates in the creamy layer are treated as unreserved and must apply against unreserved posts only Candidates who applied earlier for the same post against Advt No. 02/2022/ACD or 02/2023/ACD must re-apply afresh with updated information; they are exempt from the fee on submitting proof of earlier payment Applicants serving in Universities/Colleges/Government/PSUs must apply through proper channel and submit an NOC and Vigilance Clearance Certificate

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 20.10.2026, or 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News, whichever is later.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 43 vacancies have been notified for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor posts across 14 Schools of Studies, in addition to backlog vacancies from previous years.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for an IGNOU Professor in 2026?
faq.answer: The Professor post carries Academic Level 14 of the 7th CPC, with a pay scale of Rs. 1,44,200 – Rs. 2,18,200.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for an IGNOU Assistant Professor in 2026?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor post carries Academic Level 10 of the 7th CPC, with a pay scale of Rs. 57,700 – Rs. 1,82,400.

faq.question: Q5. What is the eligibility for IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Minimum eligibility is as per UGC Regulations, 2018 (and subsequent amendments) and relevant regulatory body norms such as NCTE and MCI, wherever applicable. The cut-off date for eligibility is the last date of receipt of online applications.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the hard copy of the application be sent?
faq.answer: To The Director, Academic Coordination Division, Indira Gandhi National Open University, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi-110068, by registered or speed post, on or before 30.10.2026.
